description: Open calls for tenders whose submission deadline falls in the next 1-90 days, soonest first, with the earliest qualifying lot deadline, buyer, CPV, estimated value and links. Filter by keywords, buyer country, CPV and authority. Deadlines are as published in the latest call notice found; a later corrigendum can move them (check the history). Price: 0.003 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"tenders_get_deadlines"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/tenders/deadlines?cpv=72&days=14&limit=10

country.description: buyer country, ISO code (DE, DEU, RS, SRB ...)

cpv.description: CPV code or prefix, 2-8 digits, e.g. 72 or 72000000

q.description: keywords in the notice text, e.g. cloud software
